{{Youmay|noninvasive devices|the title similarly spelled [[Electnode]]}}
'''Electrodes''' were noninvasive devices that could be used to create a [[Brain/Legends|neural]] connection. [[Polis Massan voicebox]]es used electrodes to turn the user's thoughts into speech.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
